Wagging Tails Charity Studio is the educational and storytelling channel of Wagging Tails Animal Rescue in North Macedonia.

We rescue dogs and cats, help them heal, and work to give them the safe, loving homes they deserve.

Through our films and educational series, we share real rescue stories and practical guidance to help adopters better understand rescued animals — their fears, their needs, their recovery and the joy of giving them a second chance.
